name: baketorio-retexture
title: Baketorio Retexture
author: ButteredCoffee
description:
New graphics for Baketorio: HD salt and trona ores, a large 3D glass greenhouse (5x7) that shows the crop it is growing and how much harvest is waiting, and with Baketorio+ an animated cow pasture as the barn (6x6).

Note: the greenhouse becomes 5x7 and the barn 6x6 tiles with this mod. Adding or removing it in an existing save resizes placed buildings.
